page.overview:
What is Victoria?

Victoria, also known as Three, is one of the overarching antagonists and twist deuteragonists in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 in the fourth and fifth books from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series. She is one of the first-generation, also known as gen1, Bobbiedots.

Three looks similar to Rose, with her bright pink coloring, but is severely damaged. The top of her face and one of her eyes are missing, exposing blackened metal beneath the smooth plastic surface. Three’s white exoskeleton is cracked, revealing part of her metal rib cage. The rest of her exoskeleton mirrors Rose’s feminine form, except for an open midsection that reveals black wires and servos. Three’s hair is made of long, black, rubbery, plastic-covered power cables that cascade from her skull like a tangle of wriggling snakes, reminding Abe of Medusa. She has one hot-pink eye, a hot-pink glow from her chest area, and a hot-pink light panel on her right thigh and on a power box midway along one of her cables.

Two weeks after the gen2s are defeated, Abe manages to find a replacement eye for Victoria. Using the pieces of plastic exoskeleton Abe found, Sasha replaces Victoria’s missing pieces.

While it is unknown how her personality was like before, it is shown that she cared about protecting the Fazplex Tower and it's tenant. When Landon Prout was planning to burn down the tower, she was forced to become aggressive and kill him.
